name: Star Wars Episode I Racer
description: Episode I Racer rebuilt on the engine: every track and pod decoded from the game's own data, textures upscaled 4x, raced with new pod physics

launch_options.label: Install directory
launch_options.help: The folder holding SWEP1RCR.EXE and data/.

launch_options.label: Track
launch_options.help: 0-24 or part of a name, e.g. 'Boonta Classic', 'Inferno'. Leave empty to choose in the menu.

launch_options.label: Racer
launch_options.help: Part of a racer's name, e.g. 'Sebulba'. Leave empty to choose in the menu.

import_notes: Reads an existing Episode I Racer install at run time and ships none of its data. Point RACER_DIR at your own copy.
